issues.message: Fact 1 (selected_device_matches_example, example_id=E3) does not match the provided data. Observed data: {"circuit": "ae_indep_tket_6", "historical_device": "quantinuum_h2_56"}. Rule: example_id required: selected_device equals that example's selected_device; this says nothing about config_id. Correct this fact; an allowed proposed pair need not change.

Fact 2 (same_qubit_count_as_example, example_id=E3) does not match the provided data. Observed data: {"circuit": "ae_indep_tket_6", "current_num_qubits": 5, "example_num_qubits": 6}. Rule: example_id required: current and example circuits have exactly the same num_qubits; this does not establish similar topology or performance. Correct this fact; an allowed proposed pair need not change.
